title: Mystic Forest Sorceress
description: A silver-haired woman in a flowing blue and purple gown stands in a glowing pool of water surrounded by lotus flowers. She reaches toward floating, glowing books that drip golden liquid while ethereal creatures and a stag emerge from swirling magical mist in an enchanted forest.
prompt: A silver-haired sorceress with long flowing hair stands in a glowing pool of water with lotus flowers, wearing a detailed blue and purple gown with floral accents. She reaches toward several glowing magical books that float in the air dripping golden liquid. Behind her is a massive ancient tree with a gothic castle built into it, under a purple aurora night sky. Ethereal purple and gold mist swirls with a glowing stag and other mystical creatures emerging from it, in an enchanted forest with waterfalls, bioluminescent plants and mushrooms, highly detailed fantasy digital painting.
